description: Angular component for device key autocomplete in a widget configuration, managing fetching and filtering of device keys based on user input and device context.

classes.name: DeviceKeyAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component for device key autocomplete, handling user input, fetching device keys, and managing form state.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and sets up value change subscriptions for filtering keys.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, clearing cache when device context changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: clearKey
methods.description: Clears the input key and refocuses input element.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: fetchKeys
methods.description: Fetches keys matching search text, with caching.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves entity keys, with caching and filtering based on device context.

methods.name: fetchEntityKeys
methods.description: Fetches entity keys from the server based on device filter and scope.

methods.name: createKeyFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for keys starting with the search query.
